prior_year_events.impact_description: The LPT reinsured 2021 & prior underwriting year business (excluding Space policies and a single Casualty policy) to a limit of 130% of the ceded reserves, increasing reinsurers' share and materially affecting prior year reserves and recoverables.

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate recorded a gross release in prior-year claims provisions of GBP 64.7m (gross) in 2024, driven by favourable development and reinsurance effects (notably the Loss Portfolio Transfer effective June 2023 which reinsured 2021 & prior business). The gross release reduced net prior-year reserves by GBP 29.08m after an increase in reinsurers' share of GBP 35.639m. The release primarily reflects favourable reserve movements across a number of lines, with material strengthening in certain classes offset by releases elsewhere.
raw_causal_phrases: Change in estimates of prior year provisions (64,719) 35,639 (29,080)

The Loss Portfolio Transfer ("LPT"), a reinsurance for 2021 & prior underwriting year, became effective at 30th June 2023. This resulted in all 2021 & prior underwriting year business (excluding Space policies and a single Casualty policy) being reinsured to a limit of 130% of the ceded reserves.

Pallas Reinsurance Company Ltd is the largest of the Syndicate's reinsurers following the LPT transaction which was executed on 30 June 2023. At 31 December 2024 the reinsurance reserves recoverable amounted to GBP 75m.
Margin of GBP 10.6m is held within the Syndicate loss reserves
In light of the elevated level of general inflation seen since late 2021, the Syndicate has considered whether this may lead to an increase in claims inflation.
As at year end on a net of reinsurance (including net of LPT) basis, a loading of GBP 0.9m is being held in respect of excess claims inflation within the Syndicate loss reserves.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

The Loss Portfolio Transfer (LPT) effective 30 Jun 2023 materially affects comparability and increased reinsurers' share; net movement differs from gross. Some LOB mappings to the standard Lloyd's list are approximate (e.g. 'Credit and suretyship', 'Assistance'). Claims development triangle (gross) available and present on page 52 for cross-check; units in triangle are GBP 000. No specifically named catastrophe events were identified.
